description: Start here: one call, no arguments, returns a short overview of the MCP server ecosystem: total number of servers in the Official MCP Registry, new servers in the last 7 and 30 days, the 3 latest MCP and A2A spec changes with a link to each source, and the snapshot date. Call it for questions like 'How big is the MCP ecosystem right now and what changed lately?'. No arguments.
name: ecosystem_overview
